description:
Cap nhat phien ban 1.3.8:
- Sua loi quet kenh TikTok tra ve 0 video khi yt-dlp khong lay duoc secUid hoac gap WAF.
- Tu dong fallback sang trang embed TikTok de lay video public, ten kenh va follower.
- Doc stderr cua yt-dlp, them timeout va retry de tranh quet im lang hoac bi treo.
- Khong can dang nhap hoac cookie TikTok cho luong fallback.
